intro: GTA VI Crash Thursday! The market got a little too real today, and our guy answered with a 16-bit phone downgrade, a reflecting pool, a no-tip barista standoff, and the best relationship advice on Stocktwits. Then he closed the night preparing his legal defense in the Wegmans produce section. Never a dull tape!

items.caption: Top post of the day! Three words and a long trailing pause, and Stocktwits felt every dot of it. Sometimes the ellipsis says it all.
Red day? He calls it a water feature. The reflecting pool is working great, and so is his sense of humor!
Tagging $SBUX for the most relatable coffee-line moment of the year: no tip today, the market's not doing so hot. Barista face included!
items.quote: $SPY $SBUX The barista face when I tell her I can't tip anything cause market not doing so hot right now.

items.caption: Financial advice so simple it hurts: just sell before it crashes, babe. Why didn't anybody think of that?!
items.quote: $SPY $TSLA "NExt time just sell before it crashes babe"

items.caption: He already called it "the GTA VI crash" this morning, and by lunch he had the clip to prove it. Too real, fam! (He quote-posted it later with "Too REAL.")
items.quote: $SPY GTA VI is too real fam!!

items.caption: Retro games fan goes full retro: the phone is now 16-bit. Blast processing for your group texts!
The classic-books brain asks the real theological question: do Teams and Zoom meetings count as purgatorial time? Asking for every office worker everywhere.
items.quote: Do you think time spent in Teams and Zoom meetings counts as purgatorial, fam?  #CatholicX

items.caption: @lordwilmehr threatened to rat him out, so he set the venue: the trial happens in the Wegmans produce section, and he admits he doesn't stand a chance. Courtroom drama among the cantaloupes!
items.quote: The trial will take place in wegmans produce section.  I don’t stand a chance!
